# Next Move Services — productregistrationinuae.com

## About

Next Move Services is a Dubai-based regulatory consultancy specialising in product registration, MOHAP approvals, and business setup in the UAE. We help brands secure fast approvals for cosmetics, food, supplements, medical devices, and more.

## Services

- **Product Registration** — Cosmetics, food, supplements, biocides through Dubai Municipality, ESMA, and MOIAT
- **MOHAP / EDE Registration** — Medical devices, medicines, pharmaceutical approvals
- **Regulatory Approvals** — Free-sale certificates, GMP verification, lab testing, halal certification
- **MOFA & PRO Services** — Document attestation, embassy legalisation, visa processing, corporate PRO
- **Business Setup** — Mainland trade licences, freezone formation (SHAMS, Meydan, SPC)
- **Trademark & Drugstore** — UAE trademark filing, medical drugstore setup
